question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a silver ball, and Claire has a yellow ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Claire swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Finally, Bob and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) silver ball
(C) yellow ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (green, silver, yellow)
1. Bob ↔ Claire: (green, yellow, silver)
2. Claire ↔ Bob: (green, silver, yellow)
3. Bob ↔ Alice: (silver, green, yellow)
Alice has the silver ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
